name: Small Stars Series 3
packaging: Purple backpack capsule, one figure inside
packagingNote: This is a Mattel Small Stars backpack rather than a Disney Doorables pack, and it holds ONE figure.
sourced: Eight figures, transcribed from Mattel's printed Series 3 display checklist and checked against collector code guides and individual figure listings. Mattel confirms the product but does not publish each wave's roster, so this remains community-sourced and is not marked verified.
rarityNote: Mattel says each wave has one hard-to-find figure, but the material reviewed does not identify which one, so no rarity is shown.
codeNote: The three-digit figure code is printed on the bottom of the backing card after the production batch text. Enter the final three digits, such as 012. Collectors mapped these codes; Mattel has not published them, so they are unofficial and may differ in another production run.
